summary.result: The results demonstrate significantly different regional variation according to the amenity variables: almost intact nature, interaction between nature and man, man-made.
summary.background: The Lorenz Curve and Gini's Coefficient derived from economics are introduced as tools for investigating and quantifying regional variability of amenity resources concentration.
summary.method: The Lorenz Curve presents a graphical view of the cumulative distribution of amenity resources and the Gini's Coefficient provides a single-parameter measure of the distributional concentration of amenity resources.
